name: Hi-Light 航轮 G7.2
why_interesting: A ¥6,500 titanium gravel frameset with an official 45 mm tire limit, six stock sizes and full geometry from a long-established Chinese manufacturer.
missing: Confirm the exact mainland frameset package beyond the frame and fork
China purchase route and domestic warranty entity
Independent or official confirmation of the retailer-listed frame and fork weights
source_note: The current official Chinese exact-model page lists CNY 6,500 retail, 700x45C maximum, BSA bottom bracket and six-size geometry. A separate retailer supplies size-M frame and fork weights. No meaningful stiffness result was found.

facts.frame: Titanium gravel frame with carbon fork
facts.frame_weight_basis: Exact-model retailer claim for a size-M titanium frame; the 491 g carbon fork is listed separately
facts.sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL and XXXL; other sizes may be customized
facts.stiffness_evidence: No exact-model instrumented stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent ride assessment was found after two full 50-area sweeps; titanium tube-shape and strength language was not treated as stiffness evidence.

observed_price.price_basis: Current exact-model manufacturer retail price for the G7.2 frameset; package, stock, shipping and checkout total require confirmation.
